general_rules.source_section_ancestry_binding: A proposition inherits the narrowest application scope established by its cited source heading ancestry unless the same cited span explicitly broadens it.
general_rules.scope_fail_closed: A claim whose inherited source scope is absent from its structured conditions is not surface-eligible.
general_rules.case_enumeration_completeness: Where the cited table enumerates rows sharing the claimed criterion, every matching named row is retained as a structured source case.
general_rules.conditional_consequence_atomicity: A source-stated limit and its immediate if-limit-insufficient consequence remain one linked claim group and may not be separated by allocation.
general_rules.source_owned_terms: New terms are claim-owned exact source data, not additions to a generic gloss or lexicon.
